description: Screens 1–50 subjects and returns a self-contained HTML report (result.html): timestamp, each list with its version / fetched-at / SHA-256, the inputs, every hit with its explanation, and an explicit no-match statement for clear subjects — suitable for the client's AML file (open in a browser, print to PDF). One charge per report. Example: subjects [{name:'Qusay Saddam Hussein', dob:'1966'}], case_reference 'KYC-2026-0412', prepared_by 'MLRO'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[] (official list pages), data_version (snapshot id), warnings[] (e.g. a list snapshot older than 7 days) and a disclaimer. Lists: ofac_sdn, ofac_cons, un, eu, uk, uae. Names are never logged; matching is deterministic (no AI) and runs offline against the bundled snapshot.

dob.description: Date of birth 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Year match adds, mismatch subtracts; omit if unknown.
dob.title: Dob

entity_type.description: individual | entity | vessel | aircraft | any (default). Disagreement with the listed type costs 20 points.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

id_number.description: Passport / national ID / registration number. An exact match on a listed number is reported as 'exact' (score 100).
id_number.title: Id Number

name.description: Full name, Latin or Arabic script.
name.title: Name

nationality.description: Nationality / country of incorporation as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ('AE', 'IR', 'GB'). Omit if unknown.
nationality.title: Nationality

reference.description: Your own row id / customer reference, echoed back.
reference.title: Reference

case_reference.description: Your case / client file reference, printed on the report.
case_reference.title: Case Reference

lists.description: Subset of lists to screen (default all): ofac_sdn, ofac_cons, un, eu, uk, uae.
lists.title: Lists

min_score.description: Minimum score (0–100) for a hit to be returned; default 85. 80 widens the net for onboarding, 92 for alert review.
min_score.title: Min Score

prepared_by.description: Name / role of the compliance officer, printed on the report.
prepared_by.title: Prepared By

subjects.description: 1 to 50 subjects to include in one report.
subjects.title: Subjects

name: audit_report
title: Produce an HTML audit report of a screening
